title: Generation of cell lines with light-controlled microtubule dynamics
protocol: Plate H1299 cells at 20% confluency in a 10 cm dish in 10 ml culture medium.
Mix 500 μl Optimem with 15 μl Lipofectamine 2000 in a sterile 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Incubate the mixture for 5 min at room temperature.
Mix 500 μl Optimem with 7.5 μg of each plasmid encoding EB1N-LOV2 and EGFP-Zdk1-EB1C in a sterile 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Mix the contents of tube 1 and tube 2 and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Add mixture dropwise to the 10 cm plate with H1299 cells.
Gently swirl the dish a few times.
Place the dish back in the incubator for ~5 hrs.
Aspirate the transfection medium.
Replace with 10 ml of fresh culture medium.
Return cells to the incubator.
Split the transfected cells 1:10 into two new 10 cm dishes.
Add 500 μg/ml G418.
Leave the cells for ~1-2 weeks.
Replace the medium plus G418 every 3-4 days.
Pick EGFP positive clones and seed in a 96 well plate.
Add 25 μl Trypsin/EDTA per well in a 96-well plate, depending on how many colonies are to be picked.
Aspirate medium from the 10 cm dish with π-EB1 expressing colonies.
Add 5 ml PBS.
Identify GFP positive colonies on an inverted tissue culture microscope with epifluorescence.
Use a P200 pipette with a yellow tip to scrape the colony from the dish.
Set the pipette to 100 μl and push the plunger down before sticking the pipette into the PBS.
Slowly release the plunger to draw up the cells after scraping.
Transfer the cells to a 96-well plate containing trypsin.
Leave the cells in trypsin for up to 10 minutes.
Add 200 μl of medium to each well after incubation with trypsin.
Place the plate in the incubator.
Alternatively, FACS sort single GFP positive cells into a 96-well plate.
Expand clones until sufficient cells are available to freeze at least one vial per clone as backup.
Seed various clones in 35 mm Mattek glass bottom dishes.
Analyze clones by Spinning Disk Confocal microscopy for EGFP-Zdk1-EB1C localization.
Select clones where EGFP-Zdk1-EB1C is clearly localized on growing MT ends.
Obtain clones with a close to 1:1 stoichiometry of both halves by visually screening cells.
Discard colonies with low MT plus-end to cytoplasm ratio or strong MT lattice labelling due to unequal or too high expression of both π-EB1 halves.
When making a stable π-EB1 cell line expressing EGFP-Zdk1-EB1C, avoid blue light exposure that inactivates π-EB1 within less than one second.
Use the EGFP signal to find cells and focus but wait for at least 30 seconds before acquiring an image to allow π-EB1 re-association.
Keep exposure time short during imaging to minimize π-EB1 photo-dissociation, which has a half-life of approximately 200 ms.
For live cell imaging of other proteins such as +TIPs, use red fluorescent proteins like mCherry instead of blue light excited GFPs.
Seed promising clones onto 6 cm dishes at 30% confluency.
Add 0.5 ml of virus containing supernatant to each of the 6 cm dishes when π-EB1 expressing cells are ~80-90% confluent.
Replace medium on Day 22.
Add 2 μg/ml puromycin to select for cells expressing the EB1 shRNA.
Expand surviving cells under puromycin selection from Day 23 to Day 40.
Analyze clones by microscopy and immunoblot to confirm shRNA depletion of endogenous EB1.
Pick clones with expression levels close to endogenous expression levels, and in which both halves of π-EB1 are present at equal levels.
Use the gRNA/pSpCAS9(BB)-2a-GFP plasmid for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knockout.
Insert gRNA coding sequence into the BbsI cloning site of the plasmid.
Sort transfected cells based on Cas9-2a-GFP expression.
Seed H1299 cells at 20% confluency in a 10 cm dish on Day 1.
Incubate the mixture of Optimem and Lipofectamine 2000 for 5 min at room temperature.
Mix 500 μl Optimem with 4 μg of each of the three gRNA plasmids targeting either EB1 or EB3.
Transfect the plated H1299 cells with the mixture on Day 2.
Mix the contents of tube 1 and tube 2.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add the mixture dropwise to a 10 cm plate containing H1299 cells.
Gently swirl the dish a few times.
Place the dish back in the incubator for approximately 5 hours.
Aspirate the transfection medium from the plate.
Replace with 10 ml of fresh culture medium.
Return the cells to the incubator.
Single cell FACS sort Cas9-2a-GFP positive cells into a 96-well plate on Day 3 or 4 after transfection.
FACS sort a population of Cas9-2a-GFP positive cells for analyzing gene editing efficiency.
Expand clones until there are enough cells to analyze by genomic PCR, immunoblot or immunofluorescence.
Evaluate clones for EB1 and EB3 expression by genomic PCR and immunoblot.
Continue experimenting with at least two homozygous knockout clones.
Freeze others as backup.
Discard clones that remain GFP positive.
Generate EB1/3 knockout cells that stably express π-EB1 as described in Protocol I Day 1-19.
Seed HEK293FT cells at 20% confluency in a 10 cm dish, in 10 ml of culture medium without antibiotics.
Incubate the seeded cells at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ incubator.
Transfect HEK293T cells with Virapower and pLKO.1 EB1 shRNA #3 using Lipofectamine 2000 according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add 9 µg of Virapower packaging mix and 3 µg of pLKO.1 EB1 shRNA #3 to 500 µl of Optimem in a sterile 1.5 ml microfuge tube (tube A).
Add 30 µl of Lipofectamine to 500 µl of Optimem in another sterile 1.5 ml microfuge tube (tube B).
Incubate both tubes at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Combine the contents of tube A and tube B by transferring tube A's contents to tube B using a 1 ml pipette, mix well, and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Add the combined mixture dropwise to the 10 cm dish containing HEK293FT cells, and incubate overnight at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ incubator.
Replace the medium with 10 ml of fresh culture medium without antibiotics, and incubate for 24 hours at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ incubator.
Collect virus-containing culture medium supernatant from the HEK293FT cells.
Centrifuge the collected supernatant at 3000 RPM for 15 minutes to remove cell debris.
Aspirate and discard medium off a confluent 10 cm dish of cells.
Add 5 ml PBS.
Scrape cells using a cell scraper, and collect cells in a 15 ml conical tube.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Add 0.5 ml lysis buffer to the pellet.
Resuspend pellet and transfer to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate on ice for 30 min, resuspending cells every 10 min.
Pellet insoluble fraction by centrifugation at 12000 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Keep supernatant.
Measure protein concentration by BCA assay.
Add 5x SDS Sample Loading buffer to samples.
Heat samples to 95°C for 5 minutes.
Store extracts at -80°C.
Perform gel electrophoresis on 10-12% SDS-PAGE gels.
Blot proteins onto a nitrocellulose membrane by wet transfer at 60 V for 1 hour.
Load 15 µg of protein extract per well for detecting EB1N-LOV2 using the anti-EB1 mouse monoclonal 1A11/4 at a dilution of 1:1000 in blocking solution (1x TBS, 0.2% Tween-20, 5% non-fat dry milk).
Load 30 µg of protein extract per well for detecting EGFP-Zdk1-EB1C using the anti-EB1 mouse monoclonal clone 5/EB1 at a dilution of 1:1000 in blocking solution (1x TBS, 0.2% Tween-20, 5% BSA).
Load 30 µg of protein extract per well for detecting EB3 using the anti-EB3 rat monoclonal KT36 at a dilution of 1:500 in blocking solution (1x TBS, 0.2% Tween-20, 5% BSA).
Incubate antibody solutions in 4 ml tubes on a rotator for all incubations.
Use secondary HRP-conjugated antibodies at a dilution of 1:5000 for detection.
Dilute EB1 gRNA#2 top strand oligonucleotides in dH2O to 200 µM.
Dilute EB1 gRNA#2 bottom strand oligonucleotides in dH2O to 200 µM.
Mix 5 μl of each diluted oligonucleotide in 1x NEB2.1 buffer for a final volume of 50 μl.
Incubate the mixture at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Slowly cool the mixture to 20°C over a 2-hour period.
Digest pSpCAS9(BB)-2a-GFP with BbsI by mixing components in a 1.5 ml tube.
Incubate the digest reaction at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add ligation buffer, annealed oligos, and T4 DNA ligase directly to the digest mixture.
Incubate the ligation reaction at 37°C for 1 hour.
Heat shock transform 5-10 μl of the ligation reaction into chemically competent DH5alpha cells.
Pick approximately 5 colonies and grow overnight cultures in 3 ml media.
Extract miniprep DNA from the overnight cultures.
Analyze clones by sequencing.
Grow 6 cm dishes of control cells and potential knockout clones to confluency.
Aspirate the cell culture medium, and add 2.5 ml PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 0.3 ml Trypsin/EDTA, incubate for 3-5 min at 37°C.
Add 3 ml of cell culture medium and collect cells in a 15 ml conical tube.
Spin down the cells at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate medium, and keep cell pellet on ice.
Extract genomic DNA using the Purelink genomic DNA Miniprep kit following manufacturer’s instructions.
Measure the concentration of the DNA using a Nanodrop UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
Run DNA on a 1% agarose gel to check quality.
Store genomic DNA at -20°C.

Perform PCR in 50 µl total volume using 50 ng of genomic DNA template, 0.5 µl Phusion Polymerase in HF buffer, 200 µM dNTPs, 4%DMSO, and 0.4 µM of forward and reverse oligos that span the gene editing site in exon 1.
Use EB1forward (CTTCCCATGCTTTAGAAGATGGC) and EB1reverse (CCCTGAACCTCTGTGTGTGGCTTTG).
Use EB3forward (CCCCAGTGCTGACCTCACCTTTCT) and EB3reverse (TTCCTTCCAGCAGGGCCACTTCCC).
Use the following PCR cycling parameters: One initial 2 min denaturation step at 95°C.
Perform 35 cycles of 20 s denaturation at 95°C.
Analyze by performing 15 s annealing at 62°C.
Continue with 15 s extension at 72°C per cycle.
Conclude with a final 5 min extension step at 72°C.
Prepare a 3% agarose gel with SYBR-safe DNA gel stain or ethidium bromide.
Separate the PCR products using the prepared agarose gel.
Use a 50 bp ladder (NEB) to determine the size of the products.
Setup a restriction digestion of 5 µg of the target plasmid in 30 µl reaction volumes.
Incubate for 4 hours at 37°C (unless the enzyme has a different optimal temperature).
Separate DNA fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis (~1% agarose for a 5 kb plasmid).
Excise the linearized plasmid from a 1% agarose gel using a clean razorblade.
Transfer the excised gel slice to a clean 1.5 ml tube.
Start the gel-extraction procedure using the Bio-Basic gel extraction kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Elute in 50 µl elution buffer.
Prepare 5x Pre-Assembly buffer by mixing 0.5 M Tris pH 7.5, 50 mM MgCl2, 1 mM of each dNTP, and 50 mM DTT.
Add 25% PEG-8000 to the Pre-Assembly buffer to make a final volume suitable for preparation.
Prepare 400 µl of 2x Assembly Master Mix by mixing 160 μl of Pre-Assembly buffer with 0.3 μl T5 exonuclease, 10 μl Phusion polymerase, and 230 μl dH2O.
Create 10 μl aliquots in 0.2 ml PCR tubes and store at -20°C.
Thaw one 10 μl aliquot of the 2x Assembly Master Mix on ice.
Add 50-100 ng of linearized plasmid to the thawed mixture.
Add inserts at a 2:1 molar ratio relative to the linearized plasmid.
Add dH2O to reach a final volume of 20 μl.
Mix well before proceeding.
Place the tube in a PCR Thermal cycler and incubate for 1 hour at 50°C.
Transform Miniprep DNA from 5-10 colonies after assembly.
